sourceText: “No,” said the other. “I cannot say that I care what becomes of Hyde; I am quite done with him. I was thinking of my own character, which this hateful business has rather exposed.”

attempts.label: primary
attempts.visibleOutput:
TRANSLATION: “Ala,” jan ante li toki. “Mi ken ala toki e ni: kama pi jan Hata li suli tawa mi. Mi pini ale e kulupu mi en ona. Mi toki insa e nimi pona mi. Pali ike ni li pana e ona tawa lukin pi jan mute.”
NOTES: “character” rendered as public reputation.
